title: LM-PUB-QUIZ: A Comprehensive Framework for Zero-Shot Evaluation of Relational Knowledge in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the softmax function to pseudo-log-likelihood scores from a multiple-choice relational knowledge probe (BEAR) and averaging the resulting distributions over all specific or generic subjects to measure disproportionate model preferences for certain geographic answers (e.g., specific continents) compared to a uniform distribution.
